proposals.source: Your request could not be sent. Try again later.
proposals.new: Không gửi được yêu cầu của bạn. Hãy thử lại sau.
proposals.context: A request send failed (network/server/revocation or unavailable at send-time). Input is retained in code. Say send did not succeed and invite retry later; do not claim acknowledgement, delivery or automatic retry.
proposals.reason: Preserves failed sending and a later manual retry invitation. Does not imply the service accepted the request, promise eventual delivery or say the input was discarded.

proposals.key: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
proposals.source: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
proposals.new: 你填写的歌曲名称和乐器筛选条件会发送到 TelemetryDeck。请勿包含个人信息。
proposals.context: Privacy disclosure in Request a song alert before an explicit Send. Song-title text and current instrument filter are sent to named TelemetryDeck service. Instruct not to enter personal information. No audio recording/transmission, anonymity guarantee, consent status or additional data category may be invented.
proposals.reason: Names the two disclosed fields and recipient, then prohibits personal information, in the locale register. The present/future wording describes the explicit-send action rather than claiming data already went out.
